content: This information was last updated in May 2024. It is important to understand how to use this information. The content provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your individual health needs. How to Use: Before starting this medication and each time you receive a refill, read the Medication Guide and, if available, the Instructions for Use provided by your pharmacist. Follow all instructions from your doctor or the manufacturer carefully before taking this product. If your doctor has provided specific dietary instructions, adhere to them. Typically, you may only consume clear liquids the day before your procedure. Avoid milk, other dairy products, red or dark-colored liquids, and alcohol. To prevent dehydration, drink as much clear liquid as possible before, during, and after taking this medication. Include a variety of clear liquids as directed by your doctor, not just water. Take this product in two separate doses as instructed by your doctor. Follow the timing of each dose carefully. This product is available as a powder in packets that must be mixed with water before use or as a ready-to-drink liquid in bottles. If using the powder packets, mix each dose with 5 ounces (150 milliliters) of cold water just before use, as directed. Watery bowel movements typically begin 2 to 4 hours after consuming the medication. This is a normal response and indicates that the medication is working. Do not take any other oral medications within one hour before starting this product, as your body may not absorb them properly. Certain medications (e.g., digoxin, iron, tetracycline antibiotics, quinolone antibiotics like ciprofloxacin or levofloxacin, chlorpromazine, penicillamine) should not be taken within 2 hours before or 6 hours after taking this product. Side Effects: Frequent, very watery bowel movements are expected after consuming this product. Other possible side effects include nausea, vomiting, bloating, headache, or stomach/abdominal cramps. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. This medication can cause excessive loss of fluids and salts, leading to dehydration. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of potential side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you have any allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this product passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription/nonprescription drugs and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Lab Tests: Laboratory tests (e.g., sodium/potassium blood levels, blood sugar levels) may be conducted before or after taking this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: If you are unable to consume all of this product and the clear liquids as directed, contact your doctor immediately. Storage: Store this product at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
